name: @breckr/shared
description: Types shared between the server and the dashboard. Types only — no runtime code.
//: There is deliberately NO main/exports runtime entry. Node refuses to strip types inside node_modules (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING), and workspaces symlink this package there — so a runtime import would fail at boot. With only `types` declared, `import type` erases cleanly while an accidental value import fails at build, where it is cheap to notice.
